name: Apricot Almond Bars
subtitle: Decadent!
notes: Hide. You might want to think about doubling this, if you have enough white chocolate.

items: 1 cup white chocolate baking pieces, melted with the butter
1 cup white chocolate baking pieces, stirred into the remaining batter

steps.title: Melt the butter and chocolate
steps.body: In a small saucepan, melt **½ cup butter**. Remove from heat and add **1 cup white chocolate baking pieces**.

steps.title: Prepare the pan
steps.body: Set aside, and grease a 9×9×2-inch pan.

steps.title: Mix the eggs and sugar
steps.body: In a medium bowl, combine **2 eggs**, slightly beaten, and **½ cup sugar**.

steps.title: Add the butter mixture
steps.body: Add the butter and white chocolate mixture and **1 tsp almond extract**. Add and stir until just combined: **1 cup flour** and **½ tsp salt**.

steps.title: Bake the base
steps.body: Spread half of the batter in the pan, and bake for 15–20 minutes or until the edges are lightly browned.

steps.title: Add the jam
steps.body: Remove from the oven. Spread evenly over warmed crust: **½ cup apricot jam**.

steps.title: Add the top batter
steps.body: Stir into remaining batter: **1 cup white chocolate baking pieces**. Then drop on top of jam.

steps.title: Add the almonds
steps.body: Sprinkle **¼ cup chopped almonds** over top of all.

steps.title: Bake until set
steps.body: Bake about 35 minutes more, or until a toothpick inserted near the center comes out clean.
